# Roadmap: Product Manager

## Role overview

Decides what to build and why, based on user and business needs.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.
- Usually 3+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [Agile & Scrum](../topics/agile.md)
- [ ] [SQL](../topics/database-sql.md)

## Also needed

OKRs, RICE prioritisation, Jira, Confluence, Productboard, Amplitude, Mixpanel

## Where it leads

Grow: AI Product Manager · Lead: CTO / CIO · Pivot: Solutions / Sales Engineer
